messages:
ana: Heads-up — Sapphire model GA next Tue 10:00 UTC. Perf sims show big token/sec uplift; need quick capacity plan (GPU-hours, region placement, cost).

sam: Got it. Can you drop the perf sim outputs and expected traffic patterns? I can run a rough GPU-hour + instance mix.

ana: @sam link to sims here: https://internal/sims/sapphire-v1 — summary below.

ana: ```
baseline model (prod): ~100k tok/s aggregate
sapphire (v1): ~260k tok/s for same batch profile
avg seq len: 384
expected qps (prod peak): 600 -> tokens/s = 230,400
end-to-end p95 target: 300ms
```

sam: Quick math: if tokens/s baseline -> gpu-hours baseline = X, new load is ~2.3x tokens/s at peak. Real GPU impact depends on batching and KV cache hit. Conservatively plan for +2x GPU-hours during peak windows.

kevin: Ballpark cost check: if we need an extra 80 A100-equivalent GPUs for 6 peak hours/day -> that's 480 GPU-hours/day. At $25/hr equivalent (blended) -> ~$12k/day incremental -> ~$360k/month. (We can refine with reserved/dedicated pricing). :money_with_wings:

maria: Note: eu-west1 has limited rack availability for A100; last procurement had delays. If we can't get EU capacity, routing EU traffic to us-central will add ~30-50ms median. That might break latency SLO for some customers.

sam: Actionable items:
- sam: run normalized GPU-hour sim with actual batching params by EOD (I will).
- ana: confirm regional % split for GA traffic (EU/US/APAC) — needed for placement.
- kevin: run cost scenarios for (on-demand vs reserved vs dedicated) and include break-even for reserved for 3/6/12 months.
- maria: check oncall runbook for cross-region fallback, list customers that require EU-only.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled Sapphire release candidate to staging for load test at 2026-03-12T22:00Z. (ci/1234)

sam: Early sim (rough) attached:
```
- baseline GPU footprint: 300 GPUs (prod aggregate across regions)
- sapphire hypothetical: +150 GPUs to keep p95 < 300ms (peak)
- extra GPU-hours/day (peak 6h): 150 * 6 = 900 GPU-hours/day
```

kevin: Updated cost: 900 GPU-hours/day * $22/hr = $19.8k/day -> ~$594k/month. If we can move 30% of workload to quantized variants (lower perf but cheaper), incremental drops to ~$400k/mo.

maria: Also watch networking: higher tok/sec means more egress to KV cache glue and tracing. We saw packet bursts in last sim causing transient 503s on the proxy layer. Need to bump proxy pool by ~25% during peak.

sam: Noted — I'll add proxy pool scale policy and a throttling guard. We should also enable prefix caching for Sapphire where applicable; that can reduce GPU cost by ~15-25% in traces.

ana: Regional split: US 55%, EU 30%, APAC 15% for GA. EU constraint is real — we may need to request Dedicated racks or fallback to lower-latency region pairs.

kevin: Suggestion: put 40% of EU traffic on dedicated reserved capacity in eu-west and overflow to us-central. Showed 2 scenarios in spreadsheet -> I'll paste link after numbers.

maria: Oncall risk: if we overflow EU->US, increase alerting sensitivity for latency p75 jump and enable customer-facing banner automation.

sam: I'll open a capacity ticket with cloud ops for expediting additional A100 racks in eu-west, cc @kevin. ETA request: 3 weeks. If not available, fallback plan in 48h.

ana: OK — can we get the rough finalized numbers by EOD tomorrow? We need to update docs and pricing page before GA.

kevin: Will push updated cost scenarios by 1800 UTC tomorrow.

sam: Final note: consider staged rollout (canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%) to smooth ramp and reduce surprise peaks. We should throttle ramp if cache miss rates spike.

ana: Agree. Thanks all — sync standup 0900 UTC tomorrow to lock decisions. :white_check_mark:
